facts.rainbow-cups: A rainbow hangs in the sky, and ten cups line up on it.
facts.couple: A man and a woman, seen from behind, hold each other around the waist and raise their outer arms toward the rainbow.
facts.children: On the right, two children dance, holding hands.
facts.home: Far off among the trees, a house with a red roof can be seen.
facts.river-hills: A river flows, and green hills spread out.
facts.blue-sky: The sky is a pale blue.
